items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: My name is Dick Allen. And the other interviewer is Bill Russell. That was a good musician too. Floyd Jackson. Very good.

ctx.x: That's right. Let me put the date on here. This is January the 18th, 1962. My name is Dick Allen. And the other interviewer is Bill Russell. That was a good musician too. Floyd Jackson. Very good.
Did he play much around the city here, Floyd Jackson? Never. Never played here. Stayed in the country. Still here. He's still here. He's still here. He's still here.
